RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts

An all-male panel is worth raising as a **process concern**, but it does not establish that sex influenced this decision. Your longer experience is relevant, but years alone do not establish who best met the criteria; digital expertise could legitimately matter.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and the policy governing panel composition. You can neutrally ask how the broadcaster ensured a fair, unbiased assessment with an all-male panel.

Inconsistent explanations, changed criteria, or sex-related comments would strengthen concerns. Check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for a response may not pause them.
